items.text: Inaki bagasesenirie abwo chinchera chiabo chire chindonge!
abwo bakorigia Omonene ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi,
Nigo nganetie ng’a chinchera chiane chibe chindonge,
Naki omonto omosae arakore arende obochenu bw’obogima bwaye?
Nase okorenda orogeendo rwaye kobwatekana ne ring’ana riao.
Nagachire ring’ana riao ase enkoro yane ime,
Nimbe ’nkona‐koraria aya onsi gwanchiikire nomonwa oo.
Nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase obonene bwe chinkuma chiao;
inyare korora amang’ana y’ogokumia y’amachiiko ao.
chingaki chionsi nigo eganetie komanya okogania kwao.
Aye nigo ogotogonyera abanto abaenenu, abwo baragereirie,
Abagaambi nabaikaransa amo koroberia bankorere bobe,
korende inche, omosomba oo, nigo nkona‐koiranerera emeroberio yao echiikire.
’ng’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
Ekero naorogetie amakora aane nigo kwanyigwete;
Inyorokererie, erinde imanye chinchera chi’amachiiko ao,
Nduserie chinchera chi’obong’ainereria chibe aare korwa ase ’nde,
Ekero oramanyie enkoro yane obuya bwao,
Aye Omonene, ’nyorokererie enchera y’emeroberio yao echiikire;
erinde ’n’yabwate na koyarenda nenkoro yane yonsi.
Oonchore enkoro yane. Yanche oborori bwao,
na toyetiga ebe nokogania kwe ribero.
Oyaonchore amaiso aane tarigereria amang’ana atagwenereti;
Ikerania ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo, eira kwandierete,
ekiagera aya gwachiikire nigo are amaya.
Rora, inche nigo ’nganetie koigwera amachiiko ao;
ing’a obogima oboyia goetera ase oboronge bwao.
Aye Omonene, orokia ase ’nde obwanchani bwao botakoera,
Tobaisa korusia nonya ng’ake ring’ana ri’ekeene korwa ase omonwa one,
Nindue oborori bwao ase amasio y’abarwoti ’ntari nobosooku.
Inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao,
Nindambore amaboko aane ’mbwate amachiiko ao nyanchete,
na nimbe ’nkorengereria igoro y’emeroberio yao echiikire.
Inyora ring’ana riao gwakwanete ase ’nde inche omosomba oo,
Ring’ana riao nigo rigonkora naba omoyia.
nonya naboigo tindi gotiga amachiiko ao.
Aye Omonene, ekero ’nkoinyora okogaamba kwao korwa kare,
Nigo ’nde n’okogeechigwa okonene ase engencho y’abakori amabe,
Ekero imenyete ase enyomba yane y’obogeni,
Aye Omonene, nigo ’nkoinyora erieta riao botuko,
Ondorere amaabera koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
Nigo nareengereretie igoro ye chinchera chiane,
Nigo ’nkobooka botuko gati kogoakera ng’a mbuya mono,
Inche nigo ’nde omogisangio bw’abwo bonsi bakoirogete,
Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo boichire ase ense,
Engencho enene ere ase amachiiko y’Omonene
Aye Omonene, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao
gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.
Inyorokererie imanye kogaamba buya na imbe ne chisemi,
Ekero konya ’ntaraegwa egesusuro, nigo nareenge omosiru,
Aye nigo ore omuya, naende nigo ogokora amaya,
Abanto abamwenu nigo bakongamba na gokwana oborimo igoro yane,
korende inche nigo ’ndendete amachiiko ao nenkoro yane yonsi.
Chinkoro chiabo nigo chinorete buna ebitinya,
korende inche nigo ’nde n’omogooko ase amachiiko ao.
Nigo yabeete buya mono ase ’nde konyora egesusuro keria,
ekiagera ayio naro agerete neorokereirie emeroberio yao echiikire.
Amachiiko ao gwakwanete nigo are amaya ase ’nde,
kobua chitaabu ne chifeta chilifu chinyinge.
ing’a obong’aini, erinde inyare kweorokereria amachiiko ao.
Aye Omonene, nimanyete ng’a ebiina biao nebia boronge,
naende ase bwegenwa bwao, nigo kwang’eire egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.
Tiga obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe bondemie,
koreng’ana buna kwariire eira ase ’nde, inche omosomba oo.
ekiagera bankoreire bobe engencho ende etaiyo,
korende inche nigo ’nkona koiranerera amachiiko ao.
Tiga abanto abwo bakoirogete bache ase ’nde.
Tiga enkoro yane ebe etari na komocha ase emeroberio yao echiikire,
Omoyo one oganyoire ase okogania ogotooreka kwao,
Amaiso aane asundokire ase okoganya ring’ana riao,
Inche nabeire buna ekerandi gi’edivai gekorire korwa ase risankwa kere ase erioki,
nonya naboigo, tindeba emeroberio yao echiikire.
Ngoika ririri inche omosomba oo ’ndagenderere koremereria?
Ndiriri oranache ekiina ase abachaandi baane?
Amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene,
korende abanto nigo bagonchaanda ase okong’aacha.
Barabwo babeire ang’e gonsiria aiga ase ense,
Ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe,
Aye Omonene, ring’ana riao nigo riteneine bokong’u
aaria igoro goika kare na kare.
Obwegenwa bwao nigo bogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi;
aye gwatenenirie ense aase aye, ero nigo eteneine bokong’u.
Ebinto bionsi nigo bigendererete kobao goika reero buna aye kwabichiigete,
Onye ogochika kwao gotarenge omogooko one
nanga nigo nasirete ase emechando yane.
ekiagera aye kwang’eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.
Abakori amabe nigo bakomboera ng’a bansirie,
Narorire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere noboikeranu,
Amachiiko ao nigo agonkora naba omong’aini kobua ababisa baane,
ekiagera ayio nigo are ase ’nde chingaki chionsi.
Inche nigo ’nde nokomanya okonge kobua aborokia baane,
ekiagera nigo ’nkona‐korengereria mono igoro y’oborori bwao.
Nigo ’ntangete amagoro aane tabaisa kobwatia enchera ende yonsi y’obobe,
Amang’ana ao naki are amansu ase ’nde!
Ee, nigo are amansu ase omonwa one kobua obooke.
ase ayio nigo ’ngeechete kera enchera y’obong’ainereria.
Ring’ana riao netaya ase amagoro aane
Natianire ng’a ning’ikeranie eira eyio yane;
nimbwatie aria onsi gwachiikire ase oboronge.
ing’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
Omonene, anchera ogosaba kwane kw’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono,
Ase chingaki chionsi tinaboegererete obogima bwane,
korende tintantaniri korwa ase amachiiko ao.
Oborori bwao nabwo omwando one goika kare na kare,
ee, nabwo enkoro yane egokerete mono.
Narure enkoro yane erende amachiiko ao,
Oborendi Obuya Bokorwa Ase Amachiiko y’Omonene
Aye naye ore obwebisero bwane, na enguba yane,
erinde ’nyaare korenda amachiiko a Nyasae one.
Ing’a chinguru buna kwariire eira, erinde imbe moyo.
Tobaisa gontiga ’ndore obosooku ase ogosemeria kwane.
inyare gosika botambe emeroberio yao echiikire.
Aye nigo okwanga abwo bagotantana korwa ase emeroberio yao echiikire;
ee, obong’ainereria bwabo nigo bore bosa.
Aye nigo obarete abakori amabe bonsi b’ense koba bosa buna amabiria;
ase ayio inche nigo inyanchete oborori bwao.
Omobere one nigo okoiguswa ore n’obwoba asore,
Inche nakorire amang’ana are ay’ekeene na ay’oboronge;
Ontenenere inche omosomba oo inyore ebisio;
Amaiso aane arosire ase okoganya ogotooreka gokorwa asore,
Engaki yaikire aye Omonene ogwenerete gokora ogokora kwao,
Ase ayio inche nigo ’nyanchete amachiiko ao kobua etaabu,
Na ase ayio nigo ndoche ng’a amachiiko ao onsi namaronge.
ase ayio nigo mbobwatete nomoyo one bwonsi.
Ekero amang’ana ao amaanoirwe nigo akorua omobaso
Nigo ngwasamia omonwa one na gwesesa,
ekiagera nigo ’nde namaiga imanye amachiiko ao.
buna egwenerete abwo banchete erieta riao.
Kong’ia orogendo rwane koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao,
Mboorie korwa ase ogochaandwa kwa Mwanyabaanto,
erio nario ndanyaare korenda amachiiko ao.
Mbarerie inche omosomba oo obosio bwao,
Nigo nkorera, naitera amariga amange mono,
Aye Omonene nigo ore omonyene oboronge,
ekiagera ababisa baane bebire ring’ana riao.
Ring’ana riao riateemirwe, nigo riteneine bokong’u,
na inche omosomba oo nigo ndianchete.
korende nonya naboigo tinkweba amachiiko ao.
Oboronge bwao nigo bore obwa kare na kare,
Oborori bwao nigo bore oboronge goika kare na kare;
on g’e okomanya, erinde imbe moyo.
Aye Omonene, nigo ’ngokorangeria nenkoro yane yonsi, inyigwe,
na inche nimbwate emeroberio yao echiikire.
Nigo ’nkobooka mambia chuni gokorangeria ng’a onkonye,
Omonene, igwa eriogi riane ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera;
ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana noboronge bwao.
abwo nigo bare aare korwa ase amachiiko ao.
Korende aye Omonene nigo ore ang’e,
n’amachiiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene.
Korwa kare nimanyete korwa ase oborori bwao ng’a
naye kwabobegete bobeo goika kare na kare.
ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
Ogotooreka nigo kore aare korwa ase abakori amabe,
ekiagera barabwo tibari korigia emeroberio yao echiikire.
Aye Omonene, amaabera ao nigo are amanene;
ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nokogaamba kwao.
Abagonchaanda na abare ababisa baane nigo bare abange,
korende tinkogobera ase okorwa oborori bwao.
Ekero nkorigereria abatari abegenwa nigo nkogeechigwa nabarabwo,
Aye Omonene, rora buna nyanchete amachiiko ao!
Ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera.
na okogaamba kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge nogwa kare na kare.
Abagaambi nigo bagonchaanda bosa ’ntari na komocha,
korende enkoro yane nigo eirogete amang’ana ao.
naba buna oyo onyorire ebisakorwa ebinge.
Nigo ngeechete kegima oborimo bonde bwonsi,
ase engencho y’emeroberio yao y’oboronge echiikire.
Abwo banchete amachiiko ao nigo bare n’omorembe omonene mono,
naende nigo ’ngokora buna amachiiko ao agoteeba.
Omoyo one nigo obwatete oborori bwao,
Nigo imbwatete amachiiko ao, na oborori bwao,
ekiagera nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi.
Aye Omonene, tiga okorera kwane goike ase obosio bwao;
ing’a obong’aini koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao!
ekiagera aye kwanyorokereirie ’manye emeroberio yao echiikire.
ekiagera amachiiko ao onsi nigo are amaronge.
Okoboko kwao, tiga kobe ang’e gonkonya,
Aye Omonene, nigo ’nde namaiga ng’a ontoorie,
Tiga omoyo one obe moyo, erinde ’ngotogie,
Inche nasirire buna eng’ondi ensiru, ’ndigie inche omosomba oo,
